node.title: Re^2: Parsing issue (null bytes?)
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
UTF-16:Unrecognised BOM 5b64 at ./test line 11. UTF-32 fails as well.

For figuring out what encoding a file is, see my comments in [id://1198033] and the replies (except for the stuff about [mod://File::BOM], that doesn't seem to apply here).

Update:

A hex dump revealed that there are definitely chars encoded above 0x7f

Can you show us?
